fact: On 21 January 2025 Cabo Verde Telecom published an EUR 18 million open tender for six new inter-island submarine segments (Santo Antao, Sao Vicente, Sao Nicolau, Sal, Boa Vista, Maio, Santiago) replacing its domestic backbone.
title: OJEU 040165-2025 CSII4 - Design, supply and installation of six segments of Cabo Verde Telecom's submarine inter island cable system
